appraisal_events.evidence: la crainte, la prudence, l'attention et la ruse avaient fini par lui donner de nous cette sorte de connaissance instinctive et presque divinatoire qu'a de la mer le matelot, du chasseur le gibier, et de la maladie... le malade; compared to naturalists making great discoveries with no laboratory.
appraisal_events.explanation: The narrator elevates Françoise by likening her servant's wary watchfulness to an almost divinatory, quasi-scientific expertise, comparable to sailors, hunters, and great naturalists working without resources.

appraisal_events.evidence: Nous avions beau... hausser les épaules, comme à une fable invraisemblable... en le faisant, la narratrice savait prendre le cassant, le tranchant de la plus indiscutable et plus exaspérante affirmation.
appraisal_events.explanation: Even as the family privately shrugs off her account of the insolent cook as implausible, Françoise's manner of telling it carries an air of irrefutable, exasperating certainty that overrides their skepticism.

status_effects.explanation: Françoise is clearly elevated by the narrator's extended comparison of her household perceptiveness to near-scientific, quasi-divinatory expertise.
Françoise gains rhetorical ground: her storytelling tone carries an air of indisputable, exasperating conviction that unsettles the family's silent incredulity.
